transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I think we need to discuss the situation with pump P-2. As we all know, it failed during the morning shift and we've got production areas without normal cooling right now. We've got a scheduled batch in the reactor suite today, and the packaging area and utilities workshop also rely on chilled water. Before we consider any temporary hose connections to restore cooling, we need to make sure we follow our standard protocols — the pre-work review covering process, maintenance, and EHS findings, and proper documentation of installation, access, and isolation controls. I'd like to hear from everyone on what they know about the situation so we can figure out the best path forward.
